summary: Injustice entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Injustice: Gods Among Us
entries.definitive_edition: Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition on Windows PC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC Ultimate Edition, or original arcade-stick console setup for launch comparison

primary.why: The PC Ultimate Edition is the cleanest one-route archive target because it includes the base fighter plus the DLC character/content set and gives the best capture/settings path. Original PS3/Xbox 360/Wii U releases are valid launch routes, but are less complete without DLC state documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use Injustice: Gods Among Us Ultimate Edition on PC. Record storefront/build, controller, resolution, DLC roster, story/STAR Labs progress, online-service state, and whether console or Vita versions were compared.

secondary.why: Ultimate Edition is the more complete one-route target.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the handheld port.
secondary.why: It is a separate access/performance route.

all_releases.platform: Ultimate Edition on Windows / PlayStation 4 / PlayStation Vita / PlayStation 3 / Xbox 360
all_releases.fidelity: Complete edition with DLC character/content set.
all_releases.reason: primary: best content/capture route on PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Ultimate Edition is content-complete; original console launches preserve first-release context.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC roster/content, controller, online state, and platform version.

entries.title: Injustice 2

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC Legendary build with exact DLC/gear/online state documented

primary.why: The Legendary Edition bundles the post-launch character/content route and PC provides the best capture/settings path. Gear, source-crystal/economy, online, and mobile companion states should be documented because they affect completeness.
primary.how_to_play: Use Injustice 2 Legendary Edition on PC. Record build, DLC roster, shaders/graphics, controller, story/multiverse/gear state, online availability, mobile-link state if relevant, and whether console/mobile versions were compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console route and separate mobile app
secondary.what_to_play: Use for platform or companion/mobile comparison.
secondary.why: PC Legendary is the best capture route for the main fighting game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Legendary Edition is the content route, while gear/online/mobile-link states remain live/account dependent.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC roster, gear/economy, and online state.
